ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is the final stage of the butterfly life cycle?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached image is a schematic diagram of the butterfly life cycle, with curved arrows connecting several stages into a cycle. On the right is a leaf, on which there are multiple groups of small oval-shaped eggs, labeled C; below is a caterpillar/larva, labeled A; on the left is a hanging pupa/chrysalis, labeled D; above is a fully formed butterfly, labeled B. Reasoning: According to the order in the image and in biology, the butterfly starts from eggs, then is a caterpillar/larva, then is a pupa, and finally develops into a complete adult butterfly. Therefore, the final stage of the butterfly life cycle is the adult butterfly.
